source: Read-only review of the frozen brief, spec, plan, test spec, graph, and both prepared Grove Trees.

evidence: packages/core/src/item.ts:40-69 defines partial autofill kind and role enums; VaultItem at :354-418 has no persisted autofillKind or provenance field.
packages/app/src/lib/1pux-parser.ts:189-283 flattens 1PUX data and skips document-only items without a loss-report result.
packages/app/src/lib/import.ts:435-515 returns VaultItem[] without provenance or structured loss data.
packages/extension/src/autofill-broker.ts:113-291 keeps plan metadata public and resolves field values only in the extension executor.
packages/extension/src/background.ts:1355-1613 revalidates targets, marks privacy before writes, and returns redacted receipts.
packages/extension/src/autofill-observation-policy.ts:35-51 has no producer for clean/allowed privacy state; no reset operation exists.
src/runtime/autofill-vault.ts:181-192 decrypts the parallel local vault in the Magic Browser process.
src/runtime/autofill-broker.ts:104-205 builds local plans/bundles and returns raw values to apply callers.
src/cli/session.ts:5367-5559 standard autofill-plan/apply/bundle/proof commands still load the local vault.
src/runtime/padloc-broker.ts:14-62 checks redaction, but PadlocBrokerResponse at :1-12 is open-ended and the guard only recognizes value/secret/privateKey keys.
src/runtime/cdp.ts:1775-1800 includes input.value in pageSnapshot; src/worker/typed-tools.ts:1025-1082 returns that snapshot and compactTypedSnapshot at :1128-1141 does not redact inputs.
packages/extension-app/src/background/service-worker.ts:853-968 dispatches page.fetch, page.screenshot, and page.observe without a Padloc privacy-status gate.

findings.title: pageSnapshot leaks input values before the planned privacy gate
evidence: magic-browser/src/runtime/cdp.ts:1788-1793 serializes input and textarea value fields.
magic-browser/src/worker/typed-tools.ts:1065-1079 returns the snapshot from open_snapshot; compactTypedSnapshot only truncates bodyText.
findings.impact: Raw credentials or personal data can cross the model-observation boundary even when no fill has happened, and the G007 matrix does not explicitly prove input-value redaction.
findings.requiredChange: Make snapshots metadata-only or redact input values at the CDP boundary, then add pre-fill and post-fill open_snapshot regression tests. Do not rely only on a later Padloc privacy-status check.

findings.title: Privacy state has no clean producer or trusted reset contract
evidence: padloc/packages/extension/src/autofill-observation-policy.ts:35-51 returns potentially-private when an entry exists and unknown otherwise; clean/allowed is never returned.
padloc/packages/extension/src/background.ts:1415-1447 maps an unknown document to requires-separate-disclosure and only checks the active tab.
test-spec.md:115-129 requires unknown fail-closed plus navigation, new-document, tab-close, and explicit trusted reset transitions, but no reset operation or owner is in the plan.
findings.impact: A literal G007 implementation blocks normal observation on every document and has no defined way to regain an allowed state; the end-to-end flow cannot reach ordinary classify/plan steps.
findings.requiredChange: Define the privacy-state state machine, clean-state authority, reset operation, and exact owner before implementation. Add the wire contract and cross-repository tests to G005/G007/G008.

findings.title: Privacy-status binding cannot prove the requested tab
evidence: padloc/packages/extension/src/autofill-broker-protocol.ts:17-31 has session/origin/frame/document fields but no tabId, formRef, or targetRevision.
padloc/packages/extension/src/background.ts:1416-1423 resolves getActiveTab() and uses only origin plus frame/document to query the ledger.
findings.impact: A non-active session target cannot be positively identified; the broker may return an unrelated active-tab state or only an unhelpful unknown, and exact tab/frame/document binding promised by the brief is not represented on the privacy-status wire.
findings.requiredChange: Add an exact target descriptor to privacy-status (or a versioned equivalent), reject active-tab mismatches, and fixture cross-tab, frame, document, and target-revision negatives.

findings.title: Importer provenance and loss-report ownership crosses a forbidden seam
evidence: plan.md:99-105 gives G001 only item.ts/core model and gives G002 only 1PUX parser/import while excluding the core model.
padloc/packages/core/src/item.ts:354-418 has no provenance field.
padloc/packages/app/src/lib/import.ts:435-515 returns VaultItem[] and has no ImportResult contract.
findings.impact: G002 cannot preserve provenance on a VaultItem or return the required imported/normalized/skipped/lossy result without either violating G001's boundary or inventing an unowned side channel.
findings.requiredChange: Land an explicit shared ImportResult/provenance contract first, assign the model/API owner, and make G002 depend on that contract. State whether provenance is persisted on VaultItem or returned as a separate durable migration record.

findings.title: Local-vault compatibility migration has no safe transport or key-custody seam
evidence: magic-browser/src/runtime/autofill-vault.ts:181-192 decrypts the local profile with a macOS keychain key inside Magic Browser.
magic-browser/src/runtime/autofill-broker.ts:104-205 can construct raw fill bundles from that profile.

plan.md:116-125 places the compatibility adapter in Padloc/G005 and the local-vault cutover in Magic Browser/G006, but assigns no encrypted-profile handoff, key custody, or no-fill-authority protocol.
findings.impact: The proposed adapter cannot read the existing keychain-backed file from the Padloc extension without either crossing raw values over CDP/native transport or silently retaining the local vault as an authority.
findings.requiredChange: Specify a user-mediated, opaque encrypted-profile import contract with provenance/loss-only output and an explicit prohibition on decrypted profile values in transport. Add exact owner paths and negative tests before G005/G006 execution.

findings.title: Passkey migration and broker dispatch both need background.ts
evidence: padloc/packages/extension/src/background.ts:150-500 contains passkey request binding, approval, selection, provider, and vault-sync orchestration.
plan.md:105-115 scopes G003 to passkey seams but omits background.ts; plan.md:116-121 gives all of background.ts to G005.
findings.impact: G003 cannot complete an explicit re-enrollment/verification flow if it needs background orchestration, while G005 can change the same file after G003 without a region-level contract or handoff.
findings.requiredChange: Assign passkey regions explicitly, split the file into owned modules, or add a non-parallel handoff with exact symbols and tests. Do not leave whole-file G005 ownership alongside implicit G003 edits.

findings.title: Padloc broker redaction is open-schema and key-pattern based
evidence: magic-browser/src/runtime/padloc-broker.ts:1-12 permits arbitrary response keys.
magic-browser/src/runtime/padloc-broker.ts:19-36 rejects only a non-empty key named value; :42-62 only validates audit.valuePolicy.
findings.impact: A raw username, password, token, body, or personal value under another key can pass the consumer guard and reach CLI/model-visible output, despite the plan's no-raw-value invariant.
findings.requiredChange: Use a closed response schema with deny-by-default unknown keys, or an exhaustive sensitive-field policy plus fixtures for arbitrary nested key names. Keep protocol-v1 compatibility explicit.

findings.title: Newly created item semantics are not connected to the creation API
evidence: padloc/packages/core/src/item.ts:475-484 puts autofillKind on ItemTemplate, not VaultItem.
padloc/packages/app/src/elements/create-item-dialog.ts:142-147 passes fields/icon but not template.autofillKind.
padloc/packages/core/src/app.ts:1569-1584 createItem has no autofillKind or provenance parameter.
findings.impact: The required normalization of newly created records is not guaranteed for template-created items, especially login, government, and financial records.
findings.requiredChange: Define whether createVaultItem derives kind/roles from fields or extend the createItem/template boundary; assign the exact app/core seam and compatibility tests to G001.

findings.title: G009 has an unprefixed cross-repository ownership path
evidence: graph-candidate.json:348-355 lists .ch5/autopilot/agentic-autofill-unification-20260918/synthetic-e2e/** without a padloc/ or magic-browser/ repository prefix.
plan.md:80-82 states graph ownership is repository-prefixed.
findings.impact: The coordinator cannot determine which Grove Tree owns the artifact or enforce the declared disjoint-path contract.
findings.requiredChange: Prefix the path with its owning repository or split the run artifact into explicit per-repository paths, then rerun graph ownership validation.

positiveEvidence: The dependency graph is acyclic and parallelWith relations are symmetric.
Padloc already has exact target revalidation, short-lived grant state, revocation generations, pre-write privacy marking, and redacted native responses.
Magic Browser already has a Padloc broker transport and rejects printable raw bundle values on native/CDP responses.
The brief/spec preserve legacy identifiers, protocol-v1 readability, synthetic-only implementation, and no working-credential mutation.
executionDecision: Do not dispatch implementation from this frozen plan. Resolve A1-A6 first; resolve A7-A9 in the same plan/spec/graph correction pass, then rerun independent architecture review.
nextGate: Return to plan review after the required contract, ownership, and privacy-state corrections. This artifact records no product or plan edits.
